t: How the Domain Classification Engine works (Signature)
title: How the Domain Classification Engine works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Domain Classification Engine does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature method uses a frozen gazetteer per domain with fixed term weights, so classification is fully deterministic and reproducible — the same text always lands in the same department. Each assignment carries a score ledger: points per matched term, the winning domain, and the margin over the runner-up. Multi-label assignments require each label to independently clear the threshold. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
